title: Stackwave
tagline: Every slab you misjudge, you lose forever.
description: Slabs sweep across the tower; drop each one where it overlaps the last. What hangs over the edge is sheared off and falls, so the tower narrows until a single mistake ends it. Land one dead centre and you get the width back.
author: HexCave
controls: Space, click or tap to drop
howToPlay: Drop each slab where it overlaps the one below.
The overhang is sheared off, so the tower only narrows.
Land one dead centre and you get some width back.
goal: Stack as many slabs as you can. Height is the score, and your best is kept.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
